node.statement: Construct the singular literal output map required by def-maincb-raw-call, rather than treating the four-corner datum as a raw-call field: define v_R^{raw}:B_R^{raw}->A_R by v_R^{raw}(x)=sum_{i,j=1}^2 phi_{ij}(q_i x q_j). Complementarity gives x=sum_{i,j}q_i x q_j, so this formula is defined on every x; it is linear because the four corner extractions and phi_{ij} are linear. Its one fixed amplification family is I_n tensor v_R^{raw}; explicitly, (I_n tensor v_R^{raw})(X)=sum_{i,j}(I_n tensor phi_{ij})((I_n tensor q_i)X(I_n tensor q_j)). Thus the four supplied amplification families determine one, and only one designated, level-one output map and its fixed amplifications; no inclusion, isomorphism, or success property is asserted here.
